description: This PHP class 'BuzzController' is part of the OrangeHRM system, specifically within the Buzz plugin. It extends an abstract Vue controller and uses traits to manage authentication and employee services. The main function preRender prepares a Vue component with employee data and sets it for rendering.

classes.name: BuzzController
classes.description: Controller handling the 'Buzz' feature, responsible for preparing employee data to display in a Vue component.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component with employee data fetched from the employee service and assigns it to the view.
